result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one content defect stands out: the second card in the 'Popular right now' list shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is a meaningless placeholder/buggy value. Other observations are minor cosmetic points. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll behavior and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section reads '-0%', a nonsensical value (zero percent discount). This looks like a placeholder or data/formatting bug and undermines trust in the promo labeling.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0 or null, or compute and display the real percentage (e.g. '-20%'). Add a guard so badges only render for discounts greater than zero.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge and the '€0 delivery' badge use a leading sign format that reads oddly for monetary/discount values; combined with the zero value it emphasizes the formatting inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent badge format such as 'Free delivery' and '20% off' instead of sign-prefixed numeric strings.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red indicator dot with no textual or badge count label, so its meaning (unread notifications) may not be perceivable by screen reader or low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label/badge count (e.g. aria-label='Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the dot has sufficient size/contrast or is supplemented by a count.
